#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Proactively reduce heat before firmware thermal protection is reached.
set -u

warning_temp=85000
critical_temp=95000
recovery_temp=70000
recovery_samples_needed=60  # 2 minutes at the 2-second polling interval
state=normal
changed_profile=0
critical_alerted=0
recovery_samples=0

max_cpu_temp() {
    local max=0 temp type zone hwmon input

    for zone in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do
        [[ -r "$zone/type" && -r "$zone/temp" ]] || continue
        read -r type < "$zone/type" || continue
        case "$type" in
            acpitz|TCPU|x86_pkg_temp)
                read -r temp < "$zone/temp" || continue
                [[ "$temp" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
                (( temp > max )) && max=$temp
                ;;
        esac
    done

    for hwmon in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do
        [[ -r "$hwmon/name" ]] || continue
        read -r type < "$hwmon/name" || continue
        [[ "$type" == coretemp ]] || continue
        for input in "$hwmon"/temp*_input; do
            [[ -r "$input" ]] || continue
            read -r temp < "$input" || continue
            [[ "$temp" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
            (( temp > max )) && max=$temp
        done
    done

    printf '%s\n' "$max"
}

alert() {
    return 0
}

printf '%s thermal-guard started (warning=%dC critical=%dC)\n' \
    "$(date --iso-8601=seconds)" "$((warning_temp / 1000))" "$((critical_temp / 1000))"

while sleep 2; do
    temp=$(max_cpu_temp)

    if (( temp >= warning_temp )); then
        recovery_samples=0
        if [[ "$state" == normal ]]; then
            profile=$(powerprofilesctl get 2>/dev/null || printf 'unknown')
            if [[ "$profile" != power-saver ]]; then
                if powerprofilesctl set power-saver; then
                    changed_profile=1
                fi
            fi
            state=throttled
            printf '%s warning: CPU/ACPI temperature %.1fC; power-saver engaged (was %s)\n' \
                "$(date --iso-8601=seconds)" "$(awk -v t="$temp" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f", t/1000 }')" "$profile"
            alert critical 'High temperature—power limited' \
                "CPU/ACPI temperature reached $((temp / 1000))°C. Power-saver mode was engaged."
        fi

        if (( temp >= critical_temp )) && (( critical_alerted == 0 )); then
            critical_alerted=1
            printf '%s critical: CPU/ACPI temperature %.1fC\n' \
                "$(date --iso-8601=seconds)" "$(awk -v t="$temp" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f", t/1000 }')"
            alert critical 'Critical temperature' \
                "Temperature reached $((temp / 1000))°C. Stop heavy work and let the laptop cool."
        fi
    elif [[ "$state" == throttled ]] && (( temp <= recovery_temp )); then
        (( recovery_samples += 1 ))
        if (( recovery_samples >= recovery_samples_needed )); then
            if (( changed_profile == 1 )); then
                powerprofilesctl set balanced || true
            fi
            printf '%s recovered: temperature %.1fC; balanced profile restored=%d\n' \
                "$(date --iso-8601=seconds)" "$(awk -v t="$temp" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f", t/1000 }')" "$changed_profile"
            alert normal 'Temperature recovered' \
                "Temperature stayed below $((recovery_temp / 1000))°C; balanced mode is active."
            state=normal
            changed_profile=0
            critical_alerted=0
            recovery_samples=0
        fi
    else
        recovery_samples=0
    fi
done
